# 2 Baruch Chapter 39 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Vision

---

**1** Hear therefore the interpretation of the cedar tree.

**2** The great forest which you saw — that represents the matter of the four kingdoms which will rule over your people, and their rule will be troubled and distressed.

**3** And as for what you saw — the cedar which remained from the forest, and the vine coming and subduing it and making nothing of it with the water —

**4** This is what it means: the last ruler who will remain from that forest of wickedness, who commanded over all of them — he will be bound and brought up to Mount Zion.

**5** And my Anointed One will convict him of all his wickedness and will assemble against him all his hosts.

**6** And afterward my Anointed One will kill him, and will protect the rest of my people who will be found in the place which I have chosen.

**7** And his dominion will stand firm forever, until the world of corruption has ended and until the times aforesaid have been fulfilled.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering. The interpretation: four kingdoms (v.2) = the standard four-empire schema from Daniel; the last cedar = the final world ruler; Mount Zion (v.4) = the site of messianic judgment; "my Anointed One" (vv.5-6) = the Messiah.*
